notes: The actual topology export contains 350 FLOOR quads and 375 SHEAR WALL quads: 15 wall quads per each of 25 storeys. The mesh is read directly from OpenSees_Element_Connectivity.json; no missing panel is synthesized.
ETABS area assignments report Slab 150 / 0.15 m and Wall 600 / 0.60 m. M45 E=33,541,020 kN/m2, nu=0.20 are source-export values; check ETABS active units and property revisions.
ShellMITC4 + ElasticMembranePlateSection is an elastic floor idealization. It is not a nonlinear RC slab model; rigid diaphragm compatibility must be reviewed before combining constraints and shells.

E-SFI-MVLEM_3D is nonlinear via FSAM but the required project ConcreteCM/SteelMPF/FSAM objects must be created before this area stage. The 0.63 thickness modifier is the E-SFI literature default for its out-of-plane bending formulation, not an NBC stiffness factor.
Do not reuse a solid-wall benchmark material as calibrated input for the perforated core without checking its specimen, boundary/pier layout, material strength and loading range against the project.
